label: INCOMPREHENSIBLE_2: infinite and comprehended by no caused intellect
term: incomprehensible, typed by its ground (incomprehensibilis; Lean `IsIncomprehensibleToCausedIntellects`)
definition: IsIncomprehensibleToCausedIntellects CausesIn esse Infinite HasIntellect C g: g is INFINITE_1 (Infinite g) and no caused intellect comprehends g: for every x that has intellect and whose being some other being causes (IsCausedIntellect, definition 80dea550), not C.Comprehends x g (the primitive comprehension relation, definition 4afe4ab4: knowing as perfectly as knowable). After ST I q.12 a.7 (no created intellect comprehends God, because God is infinitely knowable and a created intellect knows finitely). Example: on the stage-two route, any being with the nine, given the two open bridges 'Whatever is caused as to being by another is not INFINITE_1' and 'No intellect that is not INFINITE_1 comprehends an INFINITE_1 being'. Counterexample: an infinite being that some caused intellect comprehends (Control.Controls parts 3-5 of DeiFiliusImmenseIncomprehensible); a finite object, such as a theorem, fully understood by a mathematician. Not unknowability: only comprehension is negated, so INCOMPREHENSIBLE_2 is compatible with g's being known truly by caused intellects (q.12 a.7 ad 1; Dei Filius ch. 2, DS 3004, teaches that God can be known with certainty by natural reason), and with g's comprehending itself (control part 1). Distinguished from INCOMPREHENSIBLE_1 (the primitive Primitives.Incomprehensible, known by no created intellect as perfectly as knowable): INCOMPREHENSIBLE_2 quantifies over caused intellects, not created ones (creation from nothing is not typed), and relates them to g by the primitive Comprehends, whose identification with knowing as perfectly as knowable is not typed.
note: Analyst reading, attribution deferred: q.12 a.7 and q.7 a.2 motivate it; no claim states it. Sibling of INCOMPREHENSIBLE_1 (disambiguation d63d0696); the only passage between them is the open sense bridge 'Whatever is INCOMPREHENSIBLE_2 is INCOMPREHENSIBLE_1'. The infinity conjunct records the q.12 a.7 ground; it is also a convenience, since it makes the old bridge 'Whatever is INFINITE_1 is INCOMPREHENSIBLE_1' entail the new sense bridge (the strength order). Given infinity, the two bridges that derive INCOMPREHENSIBLE_2 and the sense bridge jointly entail that old bridge again, so the new route splits the old commitment into finer premises and is not a weaker total commitment. 'Not unknowability' follows from the form of this definition (it negates only Comprehends; no knowing relation is typed), not from any control model. Structural properties: none built in.
